actual_scope: Construct and prove a compact r+q-state inverse-aware frontend for complete dirty linear register programs, with exact closure certificates and finite invertible counterexamples.
scope_change_reason: Take the explicitly open inverse-relation frontend in PR5235/Discussion5236 instead of a generic formalization or the picker suggested recursive-interface cards. Supply a normalization theorem and executable bridge; no Lean or endpoint arithmetic audit is claimed.
bottleneck_link: The independent-symbol frontend cannot certify identities requiring an operator and its actual inverse. A sound compact inverse-aware bridge removes this algebraic certification gap without expanding reduced words; actual native adapters and physical invoices remain separate.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved and corroborated inverse-aware interface or a precise obstruction; do not expand to commutation/Clifford models, supplier optimization or a new kappa. At most 240 minutes including publication.
evidence: PROOF.md supplies the universal all-dimension argument. verify.py checks two feedback compilers, exact literal reduced-word and matrix oracles, complete dirty boundaries, infinite tails, certificate/syntax rejection controls and a 2^64-word stress endpoint. VALIDATION.json records replays and publication checks.
